# Choice

`import { Choice } from "@/components/agent-ui/choice"`

## Use for
- A question from the assistant that needs exactly one answer, with 2 to 5 options.

## Do not use for
- Starter prompts and follow-ups the app offers before the user has asked anything. Use `Suggestions`.
- A permission to run a command. Use `Approval`.
- More than five options or free text. Ask in a `Message` and let the user type.

## Props
| Prop | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `question` | `string` | Required. Also the radiogroup label. |
| `options` | `{ value, label, description? }[]` | Required. Two to five items. `value` is what you send back, `label` is what the user reads. |
| `value` | `string` | The selected option value. |
| `onSelect` | `(value: string) => void` | Called with the option value, not the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | After the run has moved on. |

## Example
```tsx
<Choice
  question="Which token should the divider use?"
  options={[
    { value: "border", label: "border-border", description: "Follows the theme" },
    { value: "muted", label: "border-muted", description: "Softer, easy to miss" },
  ]}
  value={picked}
  onSelect={setPicked}
/>
```

## Rules
- One question per Choice. Do not stack several in one turn.
- Options must be mutually exclusive.
- Keep going only after `onSelect`. Do not also accept the same choice typed into the composer.
